thread:
Nadia: Quick whimsical idea: swap a polaroid and a single song that matches it. No rules, just one pic + one track. I'll start with a photo of my cluttered kitchen sink and send "Electric Light Orchestra - Mr. Blue Sky" because optimism in chaos.
Theo: Love this. Mine: photo of my dog asleep on my keyboard + "Tom Misch - It Runs Through Me". Soft and dumb. :dog:
Izzy: Photo: late-night streetlamp puddle. Song: "Massive Attack - Teardrop". Moody but photogenic.
Marco: Okay travel vibe: photo of a tiny train window with fog + "Jose Gonze1lez - Crosses". Tiny reverie.
Sana: Mine is a book page with a coffee ring + "Lizzo - Cuz I Love You" for ridiculous energy contrast.
Nadia: This is delightfully specific. @PlaylistBot can you make a collaborative playlist called "polaroid-soundtrack-exchange" and drop the link here?
PlaylistBot: Created playlist "polaroid-soundtrack-exchange" and invited participants. Link: https://redwood.example/playlist/polaroid-exchange :robot_face
Theo: Also: would people be comfortable sharing actual pics in channel or should we do a shared folder?
Izzy: Shared folder please. Some folks like surprise privacy.
Nadia: Shared folder makes sense. I'll create a doc with prompts: 'what year is this polaroid from (real or imagined)? one line caption'.
Marco: Tiny contest idea: best pairing wins a printed 4x6 and the bragging rights. Prize: a sticker pack.
Sana: The stakes are shockingly high. I accept.
Theo: If someone wants a physical swap, DM me your postal address and I'll mail the print. Low-volume swaps only.
Izzy: Can we also do a mini zine with the top 8 pairings? I'll volunteer to lay out.
Nadia: Zine + prints = I will fund up to 10 copies. Micro-publisher energies.
PlaylistBot: Reminder set: "polaroid exchange submissions due in two weeks".
Marco: This thread made my afternoon. Tiny ritual that will outlive a Tuesday. :polaroid:
